positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop custom SAP Business One addons using C#, VB.NET, and SQL Server
•	Thorough understanding of ERP systems
•	Maintain and update internal software components
•	Participate in code reviews to ensure the code meets all expectations and standards
•	Owner of version control processes
•	Manage an overseas development team and coordinate projects
•	Compile and create the addon installers
•	Review and merge the teams code into the correct branch
•	Collaborate with the Products and Services team to create new features for SAP Business One
•	Utilize the proprietary SAP Business One DIAPI, UIAPI, databases, and processes

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Create C# .NET APIs that generate, receive, parse, format, and display SOAP requests
•	Query, script, compare, deploy, and maintain multiple SQL Server databases
•	Participate with senior business analysts and developers, from the largest insurance companies, to create, revise, and improve Quomation’s APIs
•	Maintain version control with Tortoise Git and TeamCity
•	Finding and fixing bugs within multiple API code bases
•	Work within an agile environment to deploy clean and maintainable code rapidly
•	QA software before production release to ensure no unexpected errors arise

positions.title: Process Operator
positions.description: As a process operator I directly interacted with the process of creating aerospace grade carbon fiber. Some of my responsibilities included quality checks of the product throughout the process, fixing or gaining help for issues with process machinery, and ensure the work area was up to 5S, LEAN, 6 sigma, and KANBAN standards.

positions.title: Process Associate
positions.description: I worked in several roles for Kennecott Utah Copper Corp. For over three years I worked at their smelter in the hot metals department; specifically where we took molten copper and cast it into anodes (large copper sheets) that would be refined further. Later I worked in their open pit mine as a heavy equipment operator, focusing on haul trucks. My last position with them was at their electroplating refinery. This was the last stop before copper and other minerals were shipped to the customer. Like my position at Hexcel there was focus on 5S, LEAN, Six Sigma, and KANBAN at all of these positions.
